basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from Austin, Texas, exploring Reddit as a way to learn more about niche interests and connect with like-minded individuals. I'm a graphic designer by profession, currently freelancing, which gives me flexible hours. I'm in a relationship and often spend evenings browsing Reddit with my partner. My interests include sustainable living, electronic music, and exploring diverse communities. Dislikes include negativity and toxic online behavior. Typically online during late afternoons and evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I studied at a local college and have been practicing for 6 years. My interest in electronic music stems from attending festivals and concerts, and I am self-taught in sustainable living practices through blogs and online communities.
